
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
extract_cicero <- function(dateipfad) {
    read_csv(dateipfad) |> 
        filter(
            Author == "Cicero",
            str_starts(Title, "Letters To")
        )
}

```

```{r}
extract_cicero("data/Namensfunde/tesserae_wildcard_homer__2026-04-16.csv")
```
